definitions.explanation: A polite term to refer to another person's wife.

examples.japanese: {奥|おく}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく}さん
{奥|おく}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく}さん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I often talk with the neighbor's wife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Mr. Yamada's wife is a very good cook and always makes delicious food for us.

notes:
{奥|おく}さん is a polite term used to refer to someone else's wife. Never use it for your own wife when speaking to others.

WIFE TERMS IN JAPANESE:
- {奥|おく}さん / ⟦{奥様|おくさま}→奥様：12337_okusama⟧: someone else's wife (polite / very polite)
- ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧: my wife (neutral, most standard)
- ⟦{家内|かない}→家内：00958_kanai⟧: my wife (humble, traditional — some consider it old-fashioned)
- ⟦かみさん→かみさん：10608_kamisan⟧: wife (casual, familiar)
- ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧: wife (casual); also means bride or daughter-in-law

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧ (inner part), originally referring to the person who stays in the inner rooms of the house.

USAGE:
Also used as a form of address for married women in general, similar to 'ma'am': {奥|おく}さん、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦{落|お}としました→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ (Ma'am, you dropped this).
